content:
maya: quick note from todays int4 ensemble canary (raven-lite -> kestrel). parse_err jumped from 0.7% -> 3.6% on funcall payloads.
oliver: same prompts?
maya: yes. failures cluster when fallback fires after ~mid-object. aggregator currently concatenates raw tokens.
sasha: example in logs: first: '{"action":"call","args":{"q":1' then fallback: ',"meta":true}}' -> invalid.
raj: so inter-model suffix overlap. short-term: force NDJSON envelope per model so aggregator can merge bodies.
oliver: alternative: insert nonprintable sentinel between model streams and strip before parse.
sasha: i'll prototype NDJSON wrapper in the canary adapter and push a draft.
raj: i'll add a trace flag to log per-model boundary token indices (toggleable).
oliver: i'll run deterministic-seed replay (1k reqs) to see if RNG is contributing.
infra-bot: canary summary: dedicated_canary_2026-03-21, 50k reqs, baseline 0.7% -> canary 3.6%. ticket INF-2026-378 created.
maya: filed fuzz: simulate mid-token fallbacks in eval harness (cheap guard). thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
